hints.title: Circle Euclidean Distance
hints.text: A point (x, y) lies inside or on the perimeter of a circle with center (cx, cy) and radius r if (x - cx)^2 + (y - cy)^2 <= r^2.

hints.title: Bounding Box Enumeration
hints.text: For each circle, only candidate lattice points within cx - r <= x <= cx + r and cy - r <= y <= cy + r can lie inside.

hints.title: Unique Point Collection
hints.text: Insert all qualifying points into a set to prevent counting points covered by multiple overlapping circles multiple times.

hints.title: Lattice Point Extraction Implementation

complexity.notes: Each circle checks at most (2r + 1)^2 points, which is small.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all points across the entire grid without bounding box per circle is redundant.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of coordinates prevents duplicate counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enumerates points within circle bounding boxes and uses set deduplication.
